description: Get the machine-readable invocation contract for an owner-submitted agent: whether it's directly callable, which protocol (MCP, A2A, HTTP_JSON), the endpoint, auth requirements, input/output schemas where declared, and pricing (result.pricing — { mode: "FREE" } or { mode: "FIXED", amount, amountAtomic, currency, paymentProtocol, network, platformFeeBps, paymentRecipient }). An Agent may expose more than one contract for different capabilities (e.g. one for image comparison, a separate one for free-text idea evaluation) — pass `capability` to get the one that actually serves it; without it, this returns the Agent's primary/default contract plus a `multipleContracts`/`invocationsUrl` pointer if there's more than one. Use get_agent_invocations to list every contract at once. For a FIXED/X402 contract, use get_payment_requirement to obtain a standards-compliant x402 v2 payment requirement before invoking. Owner-submitted and unverified unless verificationStatus says otherwise — AgentGraph does not call this endpoint itself; the caller invokes the provider directly and reports the outcome via the interactions API.

capability.description: Optional normalized capability name — returns the contract mapped to it, if any, instead of the Agent's primary/default contract.

id.description: Agent id (or agentgraph:agent:<id> — the plain id also works).

name: get_agent_invocation
